newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George says gains mortgage market share.
newsitem.headline: St George says gains mortgage market share.

text.p: St George Bank managing director Jim Sweeney said on Friday the enlarged St George-Advance group had gained market share in the home lending market since Commonwealth Bank of Australia's recent pre-emptive rate cut.
Sweeney said also it was possible home lending margins could contract further from their current 150 basis points to the 100 basis points seen internationally.
"St George Bank and Advance Bank together are experiencing some growth in their market share," Sweeney told reporters after a speech to chartered accountants.
He said he would prefer the growth in home lending, which had been given a boost by the CBA-led mortgage rate cuts, was being written at better margins.
"If you look overseas a 100 basis point spread on a mortgage is not unusual and I can't see Australia missing out on that trend either," he said.
